This week (order‑date, Tilting Heads) the lift vs 2026‑10‑09..10‑11 is concentrated in non‑ad channels and Google; Meta sales fell and stayed loss‑making. Non‑ad/organic sales and a product‑mix shift improved profitability even though total ad rupees fell (today 2026‑10‑14 is partial).

What changed (key lines)
- By channel (net sales, orders) — current 2026‑10‑12..14 vs prior 2026‑10‑09..11:
  - Meta: ₹89,987 → ₹79,054 (orders 46 → 42). Ad spend ₹108,728 → ₹100,929. Net profit roughly −₹51,429 → −₹51,474 (still a big loss); net ROAS ≈0.527 → 0.490.
  - Google: ₹40,420 → ₹47,185 (orders 22 → 24). Ad spend ₹36,539 → ₹26,742. Net profit −₹14,783 → ₹3,582; net ROAS ≈0.595 → 1.134 (much improved).
  - Non‑ad / other (ad_platform NULL): ₹43,788 → ₹64,691 (orders 20 → 34). Net profit ₹23,444 → ₹41,992 (large profit gain).
- By product (top contributors this week, 2026‑10‑12..14):
  - Play Scratch Lounge ₹18,553 (ad spend ₹4,604; ROAS ≈1.87)
  - Pawveralls Suspender Boots ₹16,731 (ad spend ₹1,019; ROAS ≈1.49) — NOTE: previously ₹35,579, so this high‑volume SKU declined.
  - Pawveralls Pro Suspender Boots ₹15,037 (ad spend ₹1,235; ROAS ≈2.98)
  - WildTrail Boots ₹12,705 (ad spend ₹6,304; ROAS ≈0.69)
  - SnugSole Boots ₹11,520 (ad spend ₹5,310; ROAS ≈0.47)
- Why it matters: the profit improvement is driven mostly by higher non‑ad sales and much better Google ROAS; Meta remains the largest ad spender and the main source of loss. A fall in a previously large SKU (Pawveralls Suspender Boots) changed mix; lower‑spend but higher‑ROAS products filled some of that gap.
